issues.title: Contributor coordination
issues.author: Veradictus
issues.body:
Contributor coordination
This issue is the shared noticeboard for matching work in rac3-decomp. It exists so that contributors and their AI agents don't duplicate each other's work.
It is a noticeboard only. It is not a task queue, a reservation database, a match proof or a record of finished work. The repository and master are the source of truth.
Every active contributor keeps one comment
Everyone matching in this repository keeps exactly one comment below.
